instructions: Prepare the labeled tray for {product.name} at {workstation.name}. Identify its order/tracking tag and keep it with the tray.
Use the configured quantities; stop and request review if the physical parts sheet differs.
Place components in their labeled tray positions and capture the complete kit for review.
part_instructions: Collect {part.quantity} × {part.name} ({part.slot_id}) from the matching labeled container. Verify its label and color before placing it in the tray.
completion_instructions: After approval, follow the next assignment. Next operation: {next.stage.name}. Destination: {next.machine.name}.

properties.instructions: Compare the photo with this order's configured bill of materials and stage instructions. Reject missing or incorrect components; do not infer equipment safety or batch completion from a photo alone. For a machine stage, a trained specialist must confirm this order's complete batch was processed before approval.

instructions: Load Gear 1 using the approved fixture procedure.
Press the machine's physical CYCLE START button. Keep clear of the guarded work area.
Wait for the physical cycle to finish, then move Gear 1 to the finished area of the tray using the approved procedure.
Repeat the approved loading and cycle procedure for G2, G3, G4 and G5, one gear at a time. Keep completed and unprocessed gears separate.

When this order's complete operation is physically finished, submit evidence for specialist review. If database signals are incomplete, a trained specialist must confirm completion; Online alone is not proof.
completion_instructions: Wait for verified process completion for this batch. A live connection alone does not prove that all five gears were processed.
Confirm all five gears are accounted for. After approval, follow the next assignment. Next operation: {next.stage.name}. Destination: {next.machine.name}.
preparation_instructions: Take the tagged tray with all five gears to {machine.name} at {workstation.name}.
Scan this machine's RFID tag.
Wait for the trolley's green indication. Stop if the indication is red.
The reference poster shows MILL_MAIN.MPF. Before operating, have the lab supervisor confirm the currently approved program; do not run a program solely because it appears in a photograph.
On the Siemens HMI, use Program Manager and the Part Program list to select the supervisor-approved program. Confirm it is active before starting a cycle.
Start observation in this interface when the assigned batch is ready, before its first physical cycle. This interface does not send CNC start or stop commands.

Named hostsOperation, not performsOperation, to avoid a real name collision found live: sf:performsOperation already existed (Order->Operation, schema-only, unused) as the inverse of operationFor. Reusing the name for this unrelated Workstation->Operation relationship silently merged both domains via RDF triple accumulation, forcing any Workstation asserted here to also be inferred as an Order -- a real BFO-disjoint contradiction (Independent Continuant vs Generically Dependent Continuant) that made the whole ontology inconsistent under a real DL reasoner.
No domain restriction — applies to Workstation and Machine. Absence of this property implies operational (true); only explicitly set where false.
Normalized observation/evidence record from sensors, PLCs, RFID, computer vision, telemetry, or application data.
One operation in a product manufacturing route, keyed by (product_id, op_seq).
